name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 1.2V — TO
description: 1.2V LDO linear regulator ICs in through-hole TO package family with TO-92 Inline footprint.
selection_hints: A 1.2V fixed output LDO linear regulator is required.
Through-hole mounting with a TO-92 Inline footprint is needed.
Using KiCad symbol parts such as MCP1700x-120xxTO.
avoid_when: Output voltages other than 1.2V or adjustable regulators are required.
Surface-mount (SMD) packaging is required instead of through-hole TO.
Footprints other than TO-92 Inline are needed.
